claim: The final E7 shatterfish Brain with its committed Playbook, the same Brain whose win rate on the standard set was published by story 7.10, is played once over every triple of the holdout set under the Rig's turn cap as the one release-level confirmation run FR-20 allows; the win rate and its binomial upper bound are published beside the standard numbers. This fixes a measurement rather than a comparison, no win rate is set to beat, and the product owner's go-ahead ("You can go-ahead on all.", 2026-10-27) is recorded in the thread of pull request 329.
